name: Aika
source: Aika is a sweet and innocent teenager who loves her friends dearly. She tends to be very caring towards the people close to her, and she loves to cook for others. Her appearance is distinctive due to her brown hair that she sports in a ponytail. She is the type of person who always tries to see the best in people and doesn't like to see anyone sad or upset. She is also a bit of an airhead and doesn't always realize what kind of trouble she can get herself into. However, despite all of this, she always has a smile on her face and enjoys helping her friends with anything they might need. Her hobbies include cooking, eating sweets, and playing video games.
